# Healthcare demo fixtures

Thirteen media files from a fictional healthcare demo produced in Sweet Tea Studio. See `sources.json` for each file's SHA-256 checksum.

| Path | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `stills/` | Four source JPEGs, including the original and cleaned Listen stills, and a 1920×1080 end card |
| `clips/` | Three silent source shots in demo order, H.264 at 832×480 and 16 fps |
| `overlays/` | Three 1920×1080 RGBA title images |
| `audio/` | Synthetic narration, mono PCM WAV |
| `reference/` | The 18-second finished demo with titles, narration, and generated music |

Tea Time Labs, LLC grants the same permissions for its rights in the included
fixture media. Product names and logos do not grant trademark rights.
